serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Lady Annalie: So. Are you going to buy these panties you were looking at?
You: !
Lady Annalie: Oh come on man, I’m only joking!
Lady Annalie: Didn’t you read the sign? No questions asked. You can look through and buy whatever you want.
#Annalie.Face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: But you have to buy everything you soil with your…{{wi}} you know what. That’s the rule.
Well… {{wi}}That rule is quite reasonable but why would you even allow someone to get to that point to begin with!
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Oh yeah! And no food and drinks here!
Lady Annalie: So! Do you want to continue shopping here? You have my full discretion of course.
Oh man… {{wi}}I don’t know if I can trust her, but she already saw me so there is not much to lose now.
You: I-I guess I will stay a little longer…
#Annalie.Face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: I’m happy to hear that! Please take your time!
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: So…
Lady Annalie: About these panties…
Lady Annalie: Were they supposed to be a present or…
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Were they maybe for personal use?
You: What about this whole ‘no questions asked’ part?! Was that a lie?!
#Annalie.Face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Don’t be such a hothead. It’s just a chit-chat! Chit-chat! Chill out!
Lady Annalie: If you want me to stop, just say so! 
You: I don’t like being interrogated, panties aren’t for me. I’m not into stuff like that.
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: What a shame.
Shame?
Lady Annalie: So you are just a normie getting a gift for your girlfriend or something, how boring!
You: Wha.
Lady Annalie: It’s so hard finding a good clientele these days… 
‘Good clientele’ my ass! This woman might be dangerous!
Lady Annalie: In case you are ready to buy something I will be in the back waiting.
#Annalie.animate(TransparencyTo0,0.4)
